description: The prisoner was the subject of the behaviour the non-association was recorded for.
The prisoner is recorded as responsible for the behaviour the non-association was recorded for. An allegation recorded by staff, not a finding or a conviction.
Neither victim nor perpetrator - the two must be kept apart without either being held responsible, for example a police request.
Not recorded. Common on records migrated from NOMIS, which did not always capture a role.
One prisoner has bullied the other.
The two prisoners are associated with rival or related gangs.
The two prisoners are linked through organised crime.
The police or a legal body has asked for the two to be kept apart, for example co-defendants awaiting trial.
One prisoner has threatened the other.
There has been violence between the two prisoners.
None of the above - the explanation is in the free-text comment.
Cell only - the two must not share a cell.
Cell and landing - the two must not share a cell or a landing.
Cell, landing and wing - the two must not share a cell, a landing or a wing. The most restrictive.
